title: 196章 命运早已都注定195章 独不见扈渎城么
lines: 听到这话，篝火旁的年轻人嬉笑之声都为之一顿，对着那个不修边幅的中年人怒目而视，半晌后，有人开口说道：“是又怎样？哪个国度没有几个软骨头？但是全国上下尽皆软骨头的又有几个？不说玉石俱焚的繁星落，多少个香火古城全城上下无怨无悔？就说接连大战之后仍旧不断驰援的张荼张先生，以及步光步先生还有苏定秦等人，你为何却是只字不提？”
那中年人灌了一口酒，讥笑道：“可是偌大神州，又有几个张荼，又有几个步光，又有几个苏定秦，你们没有看见么？即使是建邺城之中依旧有张独鹿和水心留守，更别说张荼出身的建邺城，更是有着近十位如今的巅峰强者守护！”
男子的声音之中，充满了浓浓的不甘和怨怼。
小胖子闷闷的说：“据说，建邺城是张荼一手搭建，南下也是为了寻觅故友，可是结果呢？战江城，守镇江，援建邺，入扈渎，可是换回来了什么？接二连三的自己人刺杀。换做是我，我早就掉头回转琅琊，与兄弟一起并肩作战了。还有什么比守护好自己父老乡亲来的更重要？所以，大叔，你在这里酸什么？你又有什么资格在这里说三道四？”
“就是啊！”
“你有什么资格？”
“怎么湛蓝擂台上从来没有见过你？”
篝火旁的年轻人纷纷叫嚷了起来。毕竟正是青春热血的时候，加上了秩序不断的崩溃，所有的社会规则都变成了以往约定俗成的道德规则的时候，很多人也更加的刚硬了起来，纷纷碰杯，大口痛饮了起来。
中年人的面色愈加的阴沉，但是语调却是不徐不疾的说道：“他张荼可怜，那扈渎城的数十万无辜群众就不可怜了么？你们在这里讥讽瀛州被妖族连破五城，却看不见我神洲大地已经有近乎十座古城破灭。同为人族，你们的眼界为何如此的狭隘？今时今日，应该是全人类万众一心，共同抵挡妖祸，而像张荼这种人，顶在第一线本就是应该的。”
“呵呵，什么东西，跟你讲道理你在这里胡搅蛮缠，什么叫做全人类的事业？如今妖祸肆虐？可有一人来驰援我九州？就这么跟你说吧，我九州跟瀛州，那是山川异域，不共戴天！若是他们抗住了妖祸，那么日后，也定要马踏瀛洲，扬我国威，懂么你？”
瀛州和九州的仇恨，并不久远，不过区区百余年，在大齐建国之前，瀛州曾经欲要攻破九州，虽然功败垂成，但是最终的结果却是在九州大地之上犯下了令人发指的罪行。
这一份仇恨，已经铭记在了九州每一个人的血脉之中，哪怕是没有人叫嚷着复仇，但是所有的热血之人，都在默默等待着一个机会，待到红旗满天下，马踏瀛洲赏樱花。
中年男子感叹道：“愚昧，有什么仇恨是不可以过去的，你看张荼，红颜殒命于扈渎城之中，不依旧默然放下，也没见他做什么过激的事情，不过是要了几个无关痛痒人的性命，这算的了什么？更何况是百年前的仇恨了，该过去的就过去吧。”
“放屁！”篝火旁的一个俏丽女子，骤然起身指着那个中年人呵骂道：“百世犹可复仇，更别说这区区百年，若是他日有强者预要马踏瀛洲，我林知忆得以为他摇旗呐喊，誓死追随！也决不像你这种只知道酗酒，做一个只知道放下筷子骂娘的废物！只知道抓住别人的不足，你心里是有多么的阴暗？不用在那里阴阳怪气，换做是我，我恨不得杀尽天下，别说只是处置了罪魁祸首，就算波及全族，又如何？”
中年人不紧不慢的喝了一口酒后，说道：“怎么，如今的年轻人，都这般的暴力嗜血么？杀尽天下，好大的口气。”
“嗜血？暴力？当真是个笑话。”林知忆面带讥讽之色，说道：“据我所知，如今各个香火古城，少年奔赴湛蓝擂台者有之，老年昂首战死在擂台之上的亦是有，可是唯独中年却是寥寥无几，晚辈年幼，还真不知道其中是何原因！”
这句话一出，顿时在场围观的不少中年为之一滞，甚至有不少人双拳握紧，眸中充满了怒火。其实林知忆的话语多少有些偏颇，像是如步光张荼等人其实尽皆都是中年人，不过是因为各自的传承显得颇为年轻，而张荼更是直接等于身躯重塑，自然是显得比较稚嫩，让人下意识忽略了他的真实年龄。
而且，如今的九州境内，老一辈为了不拖累自己的子女，甘心丧命于妖族口中的比比皆是，但是身为自己的中年群体又能如何？他们是如今的九州人族的中坚，势必不能如同青年一般的冲动，权衡利弊之下更是显得有些软弱。
但是实际情况不然，有的时候，活着比死亡更需要勇气。他们不是没有勇气登上湛蓝擂台，当需要牺牲的时候，冲在第一线的人，往往便是他们。但是他们同样畏惧死亡，因为生他们的人尚在，而他们所生之人尚幼，他们的抉择往往更为艰难。
“嘭！”一个满脸络腮胡的中年汉子，重重的拍打在身前的酒桌之上，闷声说道：“小女娃，你这话说的多少有些没良心，上一次群妖攻城，被打破的数个缺口，哪一个不是你口中无用的中年人，去拿命填回来的，他们哪一个不是上有老，下有小。你说血性，我等便是没有呢？可是身上的千斤担，我们倒下了，谁来抗？”
“你们也别怪这兄弟说话不讨喜，换做你们全家就剩自己一个的时候，你们未必会比他强多少，他不上湛蓝擂台，自是有他的原因……”
“刘兄……别说了！”颓废的中年男子周身气势转瞬即逝，但是却被张荼敏锐的捕捉到，张荼眼中流露出一丝有趣的神采，同时听到那男子蹲蹲了，口中语气却是缓和了很多，低沉的说道：“我并非怨天尤人，责怪谁，我只是在想，若是张荼是我们木源城的，是不是我们就不用这么苦了呢？”
张荼看到两伙人剑拔弩张，以及中年男子突然间的态度转变，顿时来了兴趣。随后便是突然将头探到了子矜的脖颈间，近乎贴着耳垂的低语道：“你觉得木源城怎么？”
感受到耳垂传来的阵阵温热，子矜只觉得浑身如同一道电流滑过周身，身形蓦然僵硬了起来，但是同样又不知道张荼什么意思，脑子更是浑浑噩噩的，下意识的说道：“这里挺好的，从外面看就是神话中的精灵古城，充满了生命的气息，跟江城等偏北方的城市有着截然不同的韵味，还是蛮喜欢的。”
“喜欢，那我们就多住一段时间吧？”
“嗯，好啊。”可是旋即，子矜便是反应过来，猛然后撤转身看着张荼，不可置信的说道：“你不是要去别的地方么？”
看着张荼那似笑非笑的表情，子矜沉默了一下后，试探着问道：“你就不怕，再遇见类似于蝎子一样的事情么。”
话音落下之后，张荼脸上的笑意顿时消散了许多，但却是平静的低声说着，像是说给自己听也像是在给子矜做出一个解释，但是子矜更感觉他是说给其他人听，说给那些已经听不见的人听。
“以前总有人说，生死有命，富贵在天。可是我总是不相信，我……只相信我自己。哪怕是后来遍体鳞伤，我也一直觉得，是我自己做的还不够好。这些其实你都知道的，但是如今我不算是最好的，但是我也不比任何人差，可是我依旧救不回蝎子。其实在大变之后，我联系到的故友，本就没有几个了……”
说到这里，剩下的话语，张荼并没有说出来，对他而言，他还需要去求证一件事儿，关于暗琼谢夕岚的事情，他要去那里看看，是不是还有一个谢夕岚在那个熟悉的城市之中，但是隐约间，他又不想去。
他在抗拒真相揭露的那一刻，他心中已经隐隐预测到了真相的可能，但是他又不想那么快的揭开这最后一层迷雾。
当然，这些他不会告诉子矜，他一直觉得，这是他和谢夕岚之间的事情，无须向其他任何人解释。

“所以啊，我现在信了，生死有命富贵在天嘛，我信了！”张荼的脸上重新露出了笑意，看着子矜说道：“你要是喜欢，我们就在这里一直住到这次的妖祸结束，你也看到了如今的木源城的实力，已经很弱了，就连地脉守护都变的脆弱不堪了，而且城墙之上亦是有了很多漏洞，如今调控能力不足，再加上人手不够，未必会有人驰援木源城，若是我们不在这里，那么这座跟神话中走出的精灵之城怕是要消失在两族的战争之中，我觉得挺可惜的，你说呢？陈憨憨。”
content_en:
Hearing this, the young people around the campfire stopped laughing and glared at the unkempt middle-aged man. After a while, someone said, "So what? Which country doesn't have a few weaklings? But the whole country is full of weaklings." How many people are there? Not to mention the fallen stars, how many people in the ancient city of Xianghuo have no regrets? Just talk about Mr. Zhang Tu, Mr. Bu Guangbu, Su Dingqin and others who have continued to come to the rescue after successive battles. Why didn't you mention it at all? "
The middle-aged man took a sip of wine and sneered: "But in such a huge state, there are several Zhang Tu, several Bu Guang, and several Su Dingqin. Haven't you seen it? Even Jianye City still has Zhang Dulu and Shui Xin guarding it, not to mention that Jianye City, where Zhang Tu was born, is guarded by nearly ten peak powerhouses!"
The man's voice was full of deep unwillingness and resentment.
The little fat man said dully: "It is said that Zhang Tu built the city of Ye by himself, and he went south to find his old friends. But what happened? He fought in Jiangcheng, defended Zhenjiang, aided in the construction of Ye, and entered Hudu, but what did he get in exchange? He was assassinated one after another by his own people. If it were me, I would have turned back to Langya and fought side by side with my brothers. What is more important than protecting my fellow countrymen? So, uncle, why are you making irresponsible remarks here? "
"That's right!"
"What qualifications do you have?"
"Why have I never seen you on the Azure Arena?"
The young people around the campfire started shouting. After all, it is the time of youth and passion, coupled with the continuous collapse of order, when all social rules have become the moral rules of the past, many people have become more hardened, clinking glasses and taking swigs.
The middle-aged man's face became more gloomy, but his tone was unhurried and he said: "He Zhang Tu is pitiful, so aren't the hundreds of thousands of innocent people in Hudu City pitiful? You are here to ridicule Yingzhou for being destroyed by monsters in five cities, but you can't see me, Shenzhou. Nearly ten ancient cities have been destroyed on the earth. We are all human beings, why are you so narrow-minded? Today, all mankind should be united to resist the evil, and people like Zhang Tu should be on the front line. "
"Haha, what are you talking about? You are messing around here. What do you mean by the cause of all mankind? The demon disaster is raging now? But there is one person who comes to help me, Jiuzhou? Let me tell you this, I, Kyushu and Yingzhou, are foreign lands with different mountains and rivers, and we are sworn in! If they resist the demon disaster, then in the future, they will also set foot on Yingzhou to promote our country's prestige. Do you understand?"
The hatred between Yingzhou and Kyushu is not that long ago, but for just over a hundred years, before the founding of the Qi Dynasty, Yingzhou once tried to conquer Kyushu. Although it failed, the final result was that heinous crimes were committed on the land of Kyushu.
This hatred has been engraved in the blood of everyone in Kyushu. Even if no one is shouting for revenge, all passionate people are silently waiting for an opportunity to wait until the red flags are all over the world and they ride on Yingzhou to enjoy the cherry blossoms.
The middle-aged man sighed: "Ignorance, there is no hatred that can't be passed away. Look at Zhang Tu. The beauty died in Hudu City. He still let it go silently. I didn't see him doing anything extreme. He just took the lives of a few innocuous people. What does it matter? Not to mention the hatred from a hundred years ago. Let the past be over."
"Fart!" A pretty woman by the bonfire suddenly stood up and pointed at the middle-aged man and yelled: "You can take revenge in a hundred lifetimes, let alone a mere hundred years. If a strong man wants to set foot on Yingzhou in the future, I, Lin Zhiyi, will be able to cheer for him and follow him to the death! I will never be like you who just know nothing. You are a drunkard, you only know how to put down your chopsticks and scold others! How dark are you in your heart? If it were me, I would kill everyone in the world, let alone deal with the culprit, so what if it affects the whole family? "
The middle-aged man took a leisurely sip of wine and said, "Why, are today's young people so violent and bloodthirsty? Kill everyone in the world, that's a big statement."
"Bloodthirsty? Violence? What a joke." Lin Zhiyi said with a sarcastic look on his face: "As far as I know, in various ancient cities nowadays, there are young people rushing to the azure arena, and there are also old people who die in the arena with their heads high, but there are only very few middle-aged people, and the juniors are young, I really don't know the reason!"
As soon as these words came out, many middle-aged people who were watching immediately froze, and many even clenched their fists, their eyes filled with anger. In fact, Lin Zhiyi's words are somewhat biased. People like Bu Guang, Zhang Tu and others are actually middle-aged, but because of their respective inheritances, they appear to be quite young, and Zhang Tu is directly equivalent to body reshaping, so naturally he looks relatively immature, making people subconsciously ignore his true age.
Moreover, in today's Kyushu, there are many older generations who are willing to die at the mouth of the demon clan in order not to drag down their children, but what can you do if you are a middle-aged group? They are the backbone of the Kyushu human race today. They must not be as impulsive as young people, and they appear to be a little weak when weighing the pros and cons.
But the actual situation is not the same. Sometimes, living requires more courage than dying. It’s not that they don’t have the courage to step onto the blue arena. When sacrifices are needed, they are often the ones on the front line. But they are also afraid of death, because the person who gave birth to them is still alive, and the person they gave birth to is still young, and their choices are often more difficult.
"Bang!" A middle-aged man with beards slapped the wine table in front of him heavily, and said in a low voice: "Little girl, what you said is somewhat heartless. The last time a group of demons attacked the city, several gaps were broken. Which one of them is not a useless middle-aged person who has to take his life to make up for it? Which one of them is not old and young? You said we have no blood, but we have fallen, who will resist? "
"Don't blame this brother for his unflattering words. If you were the only one left in the family, you might not be much better than him. He certainly has his reasons for not going to the Azure Arena..."
"Brother Liu... stop talking!" The aura of the decadent middle-aged man disappeared in an instant, but Zhang Tu keenly captured it. Zhang Tu's eyes showed a trace of interest. At the same time, he heard the man squatting, but his tone softened a lot, and he said in a low voice: "I'm not blaming anyone. I'm just thinking, if Zhang Tu is from Muyuan City, wouldn't we have to suffer so much?"
Zhang Tu suddenly became interested when he saw the tense situation between the two groups and the sudden change in attitude of the middle-aged man. Then he suddenly stuck his head into Zi Jin's neck and whispered almost against his earlobe: "What do you think of Muyuan City?"
Feeling the bursts of warmth coming from his earlobes, Zi Jin felt like an electric current was flowing through his body, and his body suddenly stiffened. However, he also had no idea what Zhang Tu meant, and his mind was even more confused. He subconsciously said: "It's quite nice here. From the outside, it looks like an ancient elf city in mythology. It's full of life. It has a completely different charm from cities in the north such as Jiangcheng. I quite like it."
"If you like it, then let's stay a little longer, right?"
"Well, okay." But immediately, Zi Jin realized what he was doing, and suddenly turned around and looked at Zhang Tu, saying in disbelief: "Aren't you going somewhere else?"
Seeing Zhang Tu's half-smiling expression, Zi Jin was silent for a moment, then asked tentatively: "Aren't you afraid of encountering something like a scorpion again?"
After the words fell, the smile on Zhang Tu's face suddenly dissipated a lot, but he whispered calmly, as if he was speaking to himself or giving an explanation to Zi Jin, but Zi Jin felt that he was speaking to others, to those who could no longer hear.
"Some people used to say that life and death are determined by destiny, and wealth is determined by heaven. But I always didn't believe it. I... only believed in myself. Even after I was bruised and bruised, I always felt that I was not good enough. In fact, you all know this, but now I am not the best, but I am not worse than anyone else, but I still can't save Scorpion. In fact, after the big change, I have not contacted many old friends..."
At this point, Zhang Tu did not say the rest of the words. For him, he still needed to verify one thing. Regarding Anqiong Xie Xilan, he wanted to go there to see if there was another Xie Xilan in that familiar city, but vaguely, he didn't want to go.
The moment he resisted the revelation of the truth, he had already vaguely predicted the possibility of the truth, but he didn't want to reveal the last layer of mystery so quickly.
Of course, he would not tell Zi Jin this. He always felt that this was a matter between him and Xie Xilan and there was no need to explain it to anyone else.
"So, I believe now. Life and death are determined by fate and wealth. I believe it!" A smile appeared on Zhang Tu's face again. He looked at Zi Jin and said, "If you like it, we will live here until this evil disaster is over. You have also seen that the strength of Muyuan City today is already very weak, and even the protection of the earth line has become fragile. It is extremely weak, and there are many loopholes in the city wall. Nowadays, the control ability is insufficient, and there is not enough manpower. There may not be anyone to help Muyuan City. If we are not here, then this mythical city of elves may disappear in the war between the two races. I think it is a pity, what do you think? "

title_en: Chapter 196: The fate has already been determined. Chapter 195: Isn’t Hudu City alone?
